Name: FS Recolourable Mermaid Pendant Accessory
Author: Thimblewitch
Description:
Just as the name tells you, it's a fully recolourable and wearable Mermaid Pendants for your farmer that works with Fashion sense. This was requested and seeing as it wasn't too much of a hassle I decided to go ahead and get it on with.

Credit to the creator of Fashion Sense cause without it we wouldn't be able to use this pack.

Downloads.Description: Fixed the Update key thank you to TheBootsElectric for bringing this issue to my attention.
